notes.title: A Note About Our First Project and Our Journey Forward
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
We wanted to take a moment to acknowledge something important.
This project was our very first attempt at making a COMPLETE game, a small learning project developed to a full game. We released it for free, knowing it wasn’t perfect, but hoping to start our journey and learn along the way.
Since then, we’ve grown a lot as developers, both in terms of skills and vision. While this game has its share of flaws (and we fully own that), it also helped us build the foundation for something better.
We're keeping this page up as a reminder of where we started, a snapshot of our first steps, and a symbol of how far we’ve come.
🎉 We’re now working on our next project:
Papi’s Playhouse, Wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686410/Papis_Playhouse/]here[/url]
It’s a multiplayer card game with hidden roles, bluffing, and shootouts, and it’s been built from scratch with everything we’ve learned over the past years.
To everyone who supported us (or even gave us tough feedback): thank you. Every comment, bug report, and review helped shape what’s coming next.
Much love,
[b]– Van Studio[/b]

notes.title: Bag Report for players
notes.content: [h3]Our first game is finally released! We did our best to deliver a bugless game, but if you encounter any bug that we may have missed or you want to discuss something with us feel free to leave a comment. Also you can use the in game bug report system. Looking forward to discuss with you and answer your questions. We hope you enjoy every moment of "Flightmare"! ːsteamthumbsupː[/h3]

notes.title: FLIGHTMARE IS AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content: [h2]We are very excited to announce the release of our first game "FLIGHTMARE" on Steam. However, we don't stop here. We have many new ideas to implement. There's more to come, so stay tuned. Thank you all for the support! We hope you enjoy this game and we look forward to your feedback![/h2]  ːsteamhappyːːsteamthisː

notes.title: RELEASE DAY
notes.content:
Hello everyone 
After 8 months of development we are very close to the release day. Today the game reached version 1.0  which was huge for us. We decide to offer some keys of the game earlier so that you to test it and most [b]important[/b] give us feedback . If you want to test our game leave a comment in the comment section of this post. Keys are not guaranteed.

Thanks for testing
